verdict.rationale: QuickBooks Online exposes a Journal Entry API (via SDKs/OAuth clients like quickbooks-gh-1, quickbooks-gh-2, quickbooks-docs-32/36) and a full-coverage MCP server (quickbooks-gh-3) that would let an agent draft and post entries programmatically, and accountant access/collaboration features exist (quickbooks-docs-10, quickbooks-docs-27). However, there is no evidence of a built-in 'draft/pending review queue' state for journal entries awaiting accountant approval before posting — QBO's API posts entries directly rather than holding them in an intermediate agent-drafted review workflow. missing for 10: documentation of a native draft/pending-approval status for journal entries created via API, evidence of an accountant-facing review/approval queue UI, and confirmation that agent-created entries can be flagged for review rather than immediately posted.
